formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic; earliest prominent surfactant is a mild anionic (Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate 2) with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants (3, 4) -> low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: the only conditioning route is Polyquaternium-10 at 11, after Parfum; no silicone, lipid, protein or prominent humectant.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PQ-10 can give noticeable wet slip even at modest levels.

weightPotential.rationale: Single late cationic polymer (PQ-10, 11), no other family -> low even under weak reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Single deposition family without reinforcement, listed after Parfum; no silicone or lipid to accumulate.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation.

focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2).

usageRole.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). Default regular; triggers (U2-U5, D1, U3) need graded claims.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). SC1 positioning unknown. CSA formula half fails: no prominent comfort or humectant/refatting route (Glycerin 24 is late).
